definition.first: first saved30Hz descending cross after successful firstWindmillContact; both endpoints t>=contact and actual front
definition.positions: linear between two existing saved positions for same ball; not an instantaneous reflection
definition.multiple: all eligible descending crossings at this plane; groups use first only
definition.scope: Downstream geometric proxy. No contact or admission causality; missing straddling/death intervals are unclassified. Road means actual recorded successful pin1..26 contact, terminal means existing fixed rectangle entry.
definition.roadTimeScope: roadRecorded/zone road/intersections mean any recorded successful first-per-pin1..26 at any time, not certified after gate/wind. Repeated later collisions are not retained by this observer; no sequence causality asserted.
definition.terminalTimeScope: Any existing terminal rectangle entry, not a guarantee of final heso path or after-wind order.

comparisons.limitation: Same shot IDs are matched observations, not identical multi-ball histories or single-contact causal pairs.
